title: A Geometric View for Understanding Concept Learning and Neuron Interpretation in Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2606.07007v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a unified mathematical framework for a geometric understanding of concept learning and neuron interpretation in sparse autoencoders (SAEs). While SAEs improve interpretability of neural networks by learning sparse feature representations, a principled definition of ''concept'' and ''learning'' remains unclear. We formalize concepts as sets of data points and cast concept learning as a set-alignment problem between human-defined and model-induced concepts. This formulation distinguishes three increasingly strong notions of learning -- detection, separation, and approximation -- and yields geometric conditions, error bounds, and capacity constraints for when concepts can be represented by individual neurons or multi-neuron units. translated_title: 理解稀疏自编码器中概念学习与神经元解释的几何视角
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个统一的数学框架，用于从几何角度理解稀疏自编码器（SAEs）中的概念学习和神经元解释。虽然SAEs通过学习稀疏特征表示来提高神经网络的可解释性，但“概念”和“学习”的原则性定义仍不明确。我们将概念形式化为数据点的集合，并将概念学习转化为人类定义的概念与模型诱导的概念之间的集合对齐问题。这一形式化区分了三种逐渐增强的学习概念——检测、分离和逼近——并给出了概念何时可以由单个神经元或多神经元单元表示的几何条件、误差界和容量约束。它还为SAE中的常见现象提供了集合论层面的解释，包括特征分裂、特征吸收、特征族和层级概念。最后，我们将概念学习与相关领域联系起来。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的数学几何框架，将稀疏自编码器中的概念学习形式化为人类定义概念与模型概念之间的集合对齐问题，区分了检测、分离和逼近三种学习强度，并从集合论角度解释了特征分裂、特征吸收等常见SAE现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified geometric framework that formalizes concept learning in sparse autoencoders as a set-alignment problem, distinguishing three notions of learning—detection, separation, and approximation—while providing set-theoretic explanations for phenomena such as feature splitting and absorption.
